row: La Carmina - Travel TV Host, Television Presenter

To collaborate with La Carmina, email gothiccarmina att gmail . com
Instagram: @LaCarmina
Website: www.lacarmina.com

LA CARMINA is an award-winning subculture / travel journalist (NY Times, BBC), author of 3 books, and a global TV host and producer (Travel Channel, Food Network, Discovery, ABC) - focusing on Goth alt fashion, Tokyo Japan, Gothic vlogs

La Carmina is a presenter / producer / creator for TV series worldwide. Her credits include NBC (Better Late Than Never), Food Network (World's Weirdest Restaurants), Travel Channel (Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern, a No Reservations with Anthony Bourdain promo, Could I Live There), Blumhouse (The Purge TV), Discovery (Oddities), National Geographic (Taboo, Roam), CTV (game show Battle of the Generations), The Doctors, Today Show, ABC Nightline, CNN & international networks (Fashion TV, NHK Japan, Canal Plus, Pro Sieben).

* CONTACT LA CARMINA: http://www.lacarmina.com
* ADD @lacarmina on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lacarmina/
